svg.text: sky jobs launch ej/job.yaml: workflow, functions and line numbers
Code: ej-prj-3-job1 5cb8dace3. Consolidation mode (sky api start --deploy): the controller runs on the API server host. Task: 6 nodes, k8s/kind-skypilot, cpus 1+, memory 1+, one echo.
Timings: medians from ej/bench_results/20261101-131411-jobs-ab, 8 runs per arm, master 815e61a76 → candidate 5cb8dace3. Client total 69.5 → 54.6 s.

Phase D is two groups in this batch: 4 fast runs at about 22 s and 4 slow runs at 28–33 s, so its median, 25.1 s, matches no actual run. Stage times are candidate medians.
Overlaps: pods bootstrap while the provisioner runs, skylet starts during the Ray wait, the controller wait overlaps E, and teardown overlaps H. Stage times don't add up to the total.
The 4.8 s storage lookup comes from the §13 probe of ej/launch_latency_consolidated_design.md. IfNotPresent comes from ej/bench_results/20261101-114555-pull-policy.
Not shown: without consolidation mode, _submit_remotely() launches a controller cluster first. Failure and recovery paths are also left out.
